scenarios.name_zh: 全栈模型公开基准工坊
scenarios.users_zh: 研究者、初创、独立评测者
scenarios.space_zh: 可计量测试台与隔离网络
scenarios.minimum_data_zh: 版本、任务、合成样本、聚合性能/能耗
scenarios.minimum_data_en: Version, task, synthetic sample, aggregate performance/energy
scenarios.human_gate_zh: 技术负责人+独立复现者签字
scenarios.no_ai_route_zh: 静态基准报告与人工咨询
scenarios.no_ai_route_en: Static benchmark report and staffed explanation
scenarios.teachback_pass_zh: 非原团队复现 3 项核心测试且偏差可解释
scenarios.teachback_pass_en: A non-origin team reproduces three core tests with explained variance
scenarios.hard_stop_zh: 数据许可不明、不可复现或越权即封存
scenarios.hard_stop_en: Unclear rights, irreproducibility or excess privilege triggers hold

scenarios.name_zh: 具身机器人安全轮班校场
scenarios.users_zh: 机器人团队、现场安全员、公众观察者
scenarios.users_en: Robotics teams, safety staff, public observers
scenarios.space_zh: 室内/围界测试湾与观察窗
scenarios.space_en: Indoor/contained test bay and public window
scenarios.minimum_data_zh: 设备状态、接管时延、碰撞/失联事件
scenarios.minimum_data_en: Device state, takeover latency, collision/link-loss events
scenarios.human_gate_zh: 双人急停与事件指挥岗位
scenarios.human_gate_en: Two-person emergency stop and incident command
scenarios.no_ai_route_zh: 静态样机展示与隔窗讲解
scenarios.teachback_pass_zh: 外部安全员完成停机、复位、撤场三项演练
scenarios.teachback_pass_en: An external safety operator stops, resets and removes the system
scenarios.hard_stop_zh: 越界、急停失效、失联或公众区进入风险即停
scenarios.hard_stop_en: Boundary breach, failed stop, link loss or public exposure stops the test

scenarios.name_zh: 模型能源与用水预算课
scenarios.name_en: Model energy and water budget class
scenarios.users_zh: 工程师、设施运营者、环境观察员
scenarios.space_zh: 计量课台与资源说明墙
scenarios.space_en: Metered resource bench and disclosure wall
scenarios.minimum_data_zh: 设备级电、水、热、时段与任务规模
scenarios.minimum_data_en: Device-level power, water, heat, time and task scale
scenarios.human_gate_zh: 能源/设施人员核验并可拒绝扩容
scenarios.human_gate_en: Energy/facility staff verify and may refuse expansion
scenarios.no_ai_route_zh: 不运行模型也能阅读的纸面标签
scenarios.no_ai_route_en: Paper label readable without running the model
scenarios.teachback_pass_zh: 维护者能重算单次任务资源并说明不确定性
scenarios.teachback_pass_en: A maintainer recomputes per-task resources and uncertainty
scenarios.hard_stop_zh: 无法计量、容量不明或安全散热未闭合即停止
scenarios.hard_stop_en: No metering, unknown capacity or unresolved thermal safety stops it

scenarios.name_zh: 隐私保护数据管家实训室
scenarios.users_zh: 数据管家、社区观察员、法律/安全人员
scenarios.users_en: Data stewards, civic observers, legal/security staff
scenarios.space_zh: 隔离数据室与合成数据工作台
scenarios.space_en: Isolated data room and synthetic-data bench
scenarios.minimum_data_zh: 分类、目的、字段、期限、权限和删除证明
scenarios.minimum_data_en: Class, purpose, fields, duration, privileges and deletion proof
scenarios.human_gate_zh: 数据责任岗位+受影响人群代表共同签字
scenarios.no_ai_route_zh: 不交个人数据的合成案例路径
scenarios.no_ai_route_en: Synthetic case route without personal data
scenarios.teachback_pass_zh: 第二数据管家能执行导出、删除和权限撤销
scenarios.teachback_pass_en: A second steward performs export, deletion and privilege revocation
scenarios.hard_stop_zh: 用途漂移、再识别风险或删除失败即暂停
scenarios.hard_stop_en: Purpose drift, re-identification risk or deletion failure triggers pause

scenarios.users_zh: 残障使用者、设计师、运维人员
scenarios.space_zh: 原点东西课程街与连续无障碍线
scenarios.space_en: Origin cross-learning street and continuous accessible route
scenarios.minimum_data_zh: 公开路网、经同意的障碍报告、短时位置
scenarios.minimum_data_en: Public route, consented barrier report, transient location
scenarios.human_gate_zh: 残障体验官拥有一票暂停权
scenarios.human_gate_en: Disabled evaluator holds an explicit stop vote
scenarios.no_ai_route_zh: 触觉/静态图、热线和现场人员
scenarios.teachback_pass_zh: 非原团队能更新障碍、发布替代线并关闭错误
scenarios.teachback_pass_en: A non-origin team updates barriers, publishes detours and closes errors
scenarios.hard_stop_zh: 错误导向、无障碍中断或申诉未响应即下线
scenarios.hard_stop_en: Unsafe routing, access interruption or unanswered appeal stops it

scenarios.name_zh: 把模型说成人话转译门诊
scenarios.users_zh: 研究者、教师、图书馆员、居民
scenarios.space_zh: 公共转译桌与可访问说明墙
scenarios.space_en: Public translation desk and accessible explanation wall
scenarios.minimum_data_zh: 模型用途、来源、限制、版本、责任与争议
scenarios.minimum_data_en: Purpose, source, limit, version, owner and contestation
scenarios.human_gate_zh: 编辑+专业责任人+居民读者共同校对
scenarios.no_ai_route_zh: 简明纸本、音频和现场问答
scenarios.no_ai_route_en: Plain paper, audio and staffed Q&A
scenarios.teachback_pass_zh: 陌生运营者能在 2 分钟内讲清用途、边界和人工入口
scenarios.teachback_pass_en: A new operator explains purpose, limits and human route in two minutes
scenarios.hard_stop_zh: 来源不清、夸大能力或投诉入口缺失即撤下
scenarios.hard_stop_en: Unclear source, exaggerated capability or no complaint route removes it

scenarios.name_zh: 青少年 AI 创客车厢
scenarios.users_zh: 学生、教师、青年机构、家长/监护人
scenarios.space_zh: 可逆课程亭与公共创作桌
scenarios.space_en: Reversible lesson pavilion and public making table
scenarios.minimum_data_zh: 作品文件、最小报名、许可与安全记录
scenarios.minimum_data_en: Work files, minimal registration, rights and safety record
scenarios.human_gate_zh: 教师终审；监护与儿童安全规则先行
scenarios.human_gate_en: Teacher final review with safeguarding first
scenarios.no_ai_route_zh: 无账号材料包与离线编程任务
scenarios.no_ai_route_en: No-account kit and offline coding task
scenarios.teachback_pass_zh: 同伴能重做作品并指出数据与版权边界
scenarios.teachback_pass_en: A peer rebuilds the work and explains data/copyright limits
scenarios.hard_stop_zh: 采集非必要未成年人数据、诱导或不当内容即停
scenarios.hard_stop_en: Unnecessary minor data, manipulation or unsafe content stops it

scenarios.name_zh: 转岗人才城市项目学期
scenarios.users_zh: 转岗者、导师、用人方、公共问题提出者
scenarios.users_en: Career shifters, mentors, employers, issue sponsors
scenarios.space_zh: 共学堂、现场教室和导师翼
scenarios.space_en: School, field classroom and mentor wing
scenarios.minimum_data_zh: 学习目标、任务版本、反馈、许可和工时
scenarios.minimum_data_en: Learning goals, task version, feedback, rights and hours
scenarios.human_gate_zh: 导师与问题提出者评议，不以 AI 自动淘汰
scenarios.human_gate_en: Mentor and issue sponsor review; no automated rejection
scenarios.no_ai_route_zh: 开放讲义、人工辅导与纸面反馈
scenarios.no_ai_route_en: Open syllabus, human coaching and paper feedback
scenarios.teachback_pass_zh: 学徒独立完成部署前检查、人工接管和退场说明
scenarios.teachback_pass_en: Apprentice independently performs preflight, takeover and retirement briefing
scenarios.hard_stop_zh: 无补偿劳动、歧视筛选或真实服务越权即停止
scenarios.hard_stop_en: Unpaid extraction, discriminatory filtering or service overreach stops it

scenarios.name_zh: 国际创始人城市落地课堂
scenarios.users_zh: 国际团队、法务/标准导师、翻译者
scenarios.space_zh: 大钟寺国际课堂与导师翼接口
scenarios.space_en: Dazhongsi international classroom and mentor-wing interface
scenarios.minimum_data_zh: 主动提交的产品、需求、许可和翻译材料
scenarios.minimum_data_en: Voluntary product, need, rights and translation material
scenarios.human_gate_zh: 专业人员终审，不生成行政或法律结论
scenarios.human_gate_en: Professionals decide; no automated legal/administrative conclusion
scenarios.no_ai_route_zh: 双语清单、人工预约与纸面路径
scenarios.no_ai_route_en: Bilingual checklist, human booking and paper route
scenarios.teachback_pass_zh: 团队能复述本地未知项、许可门与不可承诺事项
scenarios.teachback_pass_en: Team restates local unknowns, permit gates and non-promises
scenarios.hard_stop_zh: 暗示政策待遇、签约、政府背书或未经授权披露即停
scenarios.hard_stop_en: Implied incentives, deals, endorsement or unauthorised disclosure stops it

scenarios.name_zh: 有人坐席的 AI 公共服务练习台
scenarios.users_zh: 居民、窗口人员、照护者、无账号访客
scenarios.users_en: Residents, desk staff, carers, no-account visitors
scenarios.space_zh: 人工柜台、电话席与模拟服务屏
scenarios.space_en: Staffed desk, phone seat and simulated service screen
scenarios.minimum_data_zh: 公开服务目录、合成工单和转人工状态
scenarios.minimum_data_en: Public service directory, synthetic tickets and handoff status
scenarios.human_gate_zh: 一线人员拥有最终分流和纠错权
scenarios.human_gate_en: Front-line staff own final routing and correction
scenarios.no_ai_route_zh: 柜台、电话、纸面目录始终并行
scenarios.no_ai_route_en: Desk, phone and paper directory always parallel
scenarios.teachback_pass_zh: 备用人员能在断网下完成查询、记录和升级
scenarios.teachback_pass_en: Backup staff complete lookup, record and escalation offline
scenarios.hard_stop_zh: 福利/医疗/法律结论自动裁决或人工通道中断即停
scenarios.hard_stop_en: Automated high-impact decision or broken human route stops it

scenarios.name_zh: 低视力与无智能手机出行伴侣
scenarios.users_zh: 低视力者、老人、访客、交通人员
scenarios.users_en: Low-vision users, older people, visitors, transport staff
scenarios.space_zh: 全线服务点、触觉地图和静态导视
scenarios.space_en: Corridor service points, tactile maps and static signs
scenarios.minimum_data_zh: 公开路网、障碍状态、短时请求，不做人脸识别
scenarios.minimum_data_en: Public route, barrier state, transient request; no face recognition
scenarios.human_gate_zh: 现场交通/无障碍人员复核安全信息
scenarios.human_gate_en: On-site mobility/access staff verify safety information
scenarios.no_ai_route_zh: 音频按钮、热线、触觉图和人工陪行
scenarios.no_ai_route_en: Audio button, hotline, tactile map and assisted route
scenarios.teachback_pass_zh: 运营者能在设备失效时 15 分钟内切换静态替代
scenarios.teachback_pass_en: Operator switches to static fallback within a 15-minute design target
scenarios.hard_stop_zh: 关键安全信息过期、路径中断或无法告知即关闭增强层
scenarios.hard_stop_en: Expired safety data, broken route or failed notice closes the AI layer

scenarios.users_zh: 居民、景观/市政人员、维护者
scenarios.space_zh: 小月河翼、遮荫点、雨水花园与休息站
scenarios.space_en: Xiaoyue River wing, shade, rain garden and rest points
scenarios.minimum_data_zh: 微气候、积水、设施状态与匿名计数
scenarios.minimum_data_en: Microclimate, ponding, asset state and anonymous counts
scenarios.human_gate_zh: 专业人员发布预警，AI 不替代应急命令
scenarios.human_gate_en: Professionals issue alerts; AI never replaces emergency command
scenarios.no_ai_route_zh: 固定遮荫、静态标识与人工巡查
scenarios.no_ai_route_en: Fixed shade, static signs and human patrol
scenarios.teachback_pass_zh: 社区管家能复核传感器、布置替代路线并上报故障
scenarios.teachback_pass_en: Civic steward checks sensors, sets detours and reports faults
scenarios.hard_stop_zh: 设备失真、气象高风险或维护资源不足即降级人工
scenarios.hard_stop_en: Bad sensors, severe weather or insufficient maintenance triggers human mode

scenarios.name_zh: 小微商户 AI 采用诊所
scenarios.users_zh: 小微商户、导师、消费者代表
scenarios.space_zh: 大钟寺采用桌与试营业房间
scenarios.space_en: Dazhongsi adoption desk and trial room
scenarios.minimum_data_zh: 商户主动提供的流程、成本包络、权限与反馈
scenarios.minimum_data_en: Merchant-provided workflow, cost envelope, privileges and feedback
scenarios.human_gate_zh: 商户本人+消费者保护/专业角色共同签字
scenarios.no_ai_route_zh: 人工流程、普通价签与纸质合同说明
scenarios.no_ai_route_en: Manual workflow, ordinary price label and paper contract explanation
scenarios.teachback_pass_zh: 商户能停用工具、导出必要记录并恢复人工流程
scenarios.teachback_pass_en: Merchant disables the tool, exports needed records and restores manual work
scenarios.hard_stop_zh: 真实支付越权、歧视定价、供应商锁定或撤销失败即停
scenarios.hard_stop_en: Payment overreach, discriminatory pricing, lock-in or failed revocation stops it

scenarios.users_zh: 居民、访客、档案/文保人员、口述史贡献者
scenarios.users_en: Residents, visitors, archivists/heritage staff, oral-history contributors
scenarios.space_zh: 遗址公园事实墙与版本年轮
scenarios.space_en: Heritage park fact wall and version rings
scenarios.minimum_data_zh: 清权史料、出处、争议、授权和撤回状态
scenarios.minimum_data_en: Cleared source, provenance, dispute, consent and withdrawal status
scenarios.human_gate_zh: 档案/文保编辑终审，贡献者可撤回
scenarios.human_gate_en: Archive/heritage editor decides; contributor may withdraw
scenarios.no_ai_route_zh: 静态展签、人工导览和印刷年表
scenarios.no_ai_route_en: Static label, staffed tour and printed timeline
scenarios.teachback_pass_zh: 新编辑能沿来源重建一条叙事并标注不确定性
scenarios.teachback_pass_en: A new editor rebuilds one narrative from sources and marks uncertainty
scenarios.hard_stop_zh: 来源不明、权利争议未隔离或将概念写成史实即隐藏
scenarios.hard_stop_en: Unknown source, unresolved rights or invented fact hides the item

scenarios.name_zh: 城市运营者事件模拟器
scenarios.users_zh: 运营者、数据/安全人员、残障代表、事故指挥
scenarios.users_en: Operators, data/safety staff, disability representative, incident lead
scenarios.space_zh: 大钟寺事件室与可断网操作台
scenarios.space_en: Dazhongsi incident room and offline console
scenarios.minimum_data_zh: 纯合成事件、角色、时钟、决策差异和恢复证据
scenarios.minimum_data_en: Synthetic incident, roles, clock, decision diff and recovery proof
scenarios.human_gate_zh: 未参与原决定的独立评议者主持复盘
scenarios.human_gate_en: Independent reviewer not in the original decision leads review
scenarios.no_ai_route_zh: 电话树、纸本手册、机械急停与现场集合点
scenarios.no_ai_route_en: Phone tree, paper manual, physical stop and assembly point
scenarios.teachback_pass_zh: 备用班组完成停机、通知、人工服务、恢复和退场五联演练
scenarios.teachback_pass_en: Backup shift performs stop, notice, manual service, recovery and exit
scenarios.hard_stop_zh: 接管超时、日志缺失、角色冲突或无法恢复即不毕业
scenarios.hard_stop_en: Late takeover, missing log, role conflict or failed recovery blocks graduation

scenarios.name_zh: 采用、维护与退场毕业台
scenarios.users_zh: 运营者、采购/法务、居民、学徒、独立评估者
scenarios.users_en: Operators, procurement/legal, residents, apprentices, independent evaluator
scenarios.space_zh: 毕业答辩厅、维护工位和退场仓
scenarios.space_en: Graduation jury, maintenance bay and exit store
scenarios.minimum_data_zh: 场景证据、人员能力、成本状态、申诉、资产去向
scenarios.minimum_data_en: Scenario evidence, capability, cost status, appeals and asset fate
scenarios.human_gate_zh: 五席人类答辩；受影响群体一席不可省略
scenarios.human_gate_en: Five-seat human jury with a mandatory affected-group seat
scenarios.no_ai_route_zh: 不采用 AI 的服务和完整退场方案
scenarios.no_ai_route_en: No-AI service and complete retirement option
scenarios.teachback_pass_zh: 非原团队解释、运行、接管、修复、导出和退场全部通过
scenarios.teachback_pass_en: Non-origin team explains, runs, takes over, repairs, exports and retires it
scenarios.hard_stop_zh: 责任人、持续资源、申诉、退出资产任一不清楚即退修或退场
scenarios.hard_stop_en: Unclear owner, sustained resource, appeal or asset exit means revise or retire
